essence: The speaker affirms having respectfully witnessed all such women.
Women born from those lineages are recognized as rudragaṇikās.
Having been asked, the speaker instructs the audience to listen to his answer.
The defining nature of pure dance is that taught by Bharata.
Pure dance is performed by lineage-born women together with five teachers.
